Break the robot

the AI.

You and Muse, Meta's frontier model, take turns attacking the same walking robot. Same robot, same 8 random seeds, one attack each per round, written at the same time. The subtlest attack that still knocks it over wins.

Then the robot trains on everything that broke it, from both of you.

Muse commits to a hash of its attack before you type yours. Your browser verifies it at the reveal.

How it works

Subtle beats brutal.

01 / Describe
"a light shove from the
right as it turns, on
slightly wet floor"

Say it in words

Type or speak. Muse Wonder turns your sentence into physics: friction, pushes, payloads, slopes, weak motors, sensor lag.

02 / Same seeds

8 tries each

Both attacks run on the same live robot with the same 8 random starts. Each orange square is a fall.

03 / Subtlety
ice + 150 Nwet floor + nudge

Smallest change wins

Score = falls × subtlety. If even our toughest robot can't survive it, it's brute force and scores 0.

04 / Learn
v3→v4

The robot learns

After the duel, retrain the live robot on every fair attack that broke it. A regression gate keeps it honest.
